description: Use this to verify up to 25 UK (Companies House, max 10), Australian (ACN/ABN), Canadian (corp number/BN), French (SIREN), Norwegian (orgnr), Danish (CVR), Finnish (Y-tunnus), Swiss (UID), Polish (KRS), Czech (IČO), Belgian (enterprise number), Slovak (RPO IČO), Irish (CRO number), Estonian (äriregister code), Latvian (registration number), Singapore ACRA (sg=UEN) and US state (us=STATE:ID — NY/CO/CT/OR/TX/VA Secretary of State open data; state prefix required because ids collide across states) companies in one call: name, status, type, dates, UK red flags. Comma-separated ids; bad items get an inline per-item error. Example: {uk:"00445790", us:"NY:3368051,OR:8739914"}. Free sample: /samples/registry-batch. $0.30 USDC. Related: Screen the directors/names: /sanctions-batch $1 (<=50).

us.description: US state entities as STATE:ID, comma-separated, e.g. NY:3368051,CO:20161660970
